notes.title: Queen Ellis revealed in 4K, (plus development news!)
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, everyone!

I do apologize on being late with this, but here is the final wallpaper in the series. The TL;DR of everything I'm about to say is "We're back to the grind!"

The long version:

Losing Biscuit rocked me. It's been a long time since i've experienced grief [b]that[/b] substantially. If I'm honest, a small part of me thought that it may be MONTHS on end, before I'd be emotionally stable enough to get back to game work.

But, even then, i was making forward progress, as much as I could stand to, while saying goodbye to Biscuit. Today, that progress kicked up quite a bit, and I felt all the old motivations coming back MUCH sooner than I thought they would.

I would apologize for the slowdown, but grief is grief, and Biscuit was my best friend. Taking time to grieve that loss is not something I feel the need to apologize for. But, that said, we're back at it now! And I'm kicking off the renewed work vigor with the final shot in the wallpaper series! :)

The uncompressed version of this image can be found [url="https://upload.dgfiles.com/f/58e91de03bee442bbcf1df7d382619ce"]here![/url]

If anyone has any questions, please feel free to hit me up either here, or on Discord.

Best wishes, everyone, and I really AM excited to get this next update done! :)

~ Paper Tiger

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529429/7498e509c3c54b0075013cd1b80bdc9e2c00452a.jpg"][/img]

[/p]

notes.title: Small content patch!
notes.notes: [p]Hey guys!  It seems Steam may be aiming to cut a particular kind of content from NSFW titles, and - just to be safe - I'm removing one scene that may have potentially violated some new rules that may (or may not) be placed into effect.   [/p][p][/p][p]Just wanted to keep everyone updated, and be as transparent as I can. If at any time later it is determined that Steam does not intend to ban all games containing nonconsensual content, then I will bring it back. But until such a time, I'd rather be safe than sorry.   The only scene to be cut was a fairly obscure bad end, anyway.   More details will be available on the [url="https://discord.gg/fTqXazge75"]Discord[/url], if anyone has any questions![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Due to new security changes at Steam, I am not currently able to publish this update, and will not be able to for 72 hours. But it will be posted as soon as I'm able.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][u]In future update news:[/u]  [/p][p][/p][p]The next update is well underway, and approaching ~70% completion, so it won't be too long now! :)[/p]

notes.title: Development Cycle News!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Now that the game is on steam, it's time to make some final statements on the development cycle, if anyone is interested to hear, please read below :)[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]So, i always tried to keep to within a 3 month release window. That was a rule i set as soon as I launched the first demo. That said, I had never had any game development experience prior to setting that rule for myself, and i see now that attempting to adhere to that can lead to rushed situations, under which the quality of the game, or length of the content (or both) will suffer.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]On the subject of quality, I do try(hard) to keep the writing, the renders and the animations as high quality as i can manage with my current skills, which are always developing :) But quality takes time for a solo indie dev. I can produce quality releases, or quick releases. I can't do both. I've settled on quality, since I want to be able to look back and be proud of the game. I think it's clear by this point that it's not going to be a game that stuffs itself full of the latest nsfw fads. It has an actual story, and one that means a lot to me. I intend to do it justice in my mind :)[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]But that means that official release dates, or even windows, are now a thing of the past. Every update has a designated end point. The goal now will simply be to work on that until it gets there, without being under a clock, which would cause the usual issues that come with rushing. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Though I announced that the previous release will be made public, I've decided to postpone it, as it was simply much too short. To the point that it would be a genuine disservice to those who are waiting on the next continuation of the story. That update was intended to be a good bit longer, and im working on completing it up to its original designated end point now.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Lastly, versioning got a bit off track with the last few updates. The next update will be version 0.3.2, in order to bring it up to speed with the development plan.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Now, with all those new solo dev mistakes out of the way ... I'm open to any questions anyone may have! :)[/p]

notes.title: Wrap-up Mode!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

          The next update has officially moved into the wrap-up/production phase! 


          On that note, it will probably be the smallest update ever, in terms of linear time. It will stop just short of continuing the main cast's story, and i wanted to explain that, for any who care to know why. (dev heavy stuff, so if that's an immersion breaker i get it, but for those who want to know...)

          This scene, while very short linearly, took me nearly 3 months, due to the fact that it branches into two separate paths (hetero or lesbian) , that each have 3 custom animations. If you have straight content disabled, then it will default to the lesbian path, if you do not, then you will be given the choice of which path to follow. 

          6 animations took 95% of all that time, easy, and there really isn't any way around that. Animations just take time. 

          I was going to wait until the first branch of the following scene is complete, and release that as the next update, but it's going to take just as long, if not longer, and i do my best to stick to 3 month release cycles, regardless of content size. 

          I know some AVN players like to skip updates from time to time, so that when they return, there's that much more content to enjoy. I'm gonna be honest with you. If you're one of those types, this would be the update to skip ːsteamhappyː

          But as i said, i try to stick as close to a steady 3 month release cycle as i can, and if i wait until the scene following this one is done, it'll put me at more like 6-7 months since the last update. I'd just prefer to keep it to the 3 months cycle.

Anyway, that's the news!

Hope everyone had a great Memorial Day Weekend!

~ Paper Tiger

notes.title: Progress Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

Here with a status update! 

So, while trying not to be too long winded, or spoilery, here's where we're at:

[list]
[*]This update structure contains a linear scene, as well as the first part of a massive free-roam. The linear scene is completely written and rendered, starting on animation work today ... 

[*]The *framework* for the freeroam segment has all been built (from scratch), mapped and rendered in full. I tested it yesterday, everything's flowing like a champ!

[*]There [b]are[/b] close to 20 events that branch off of it, though. I've got ~80% of those side events written, with 2 completely rendered, as well as a bit of the third. So, all in all, i'd say this update is about ~15% complete.
[/list]

If I get this first path of the freeroam done in an acceptable amount of time, then i will include the second branch as part of this update as well. But we'll see where things land :) I want to try to keep everything within a 3 months release cycle, as best i can. (This isn't a guarantee, just a rough timeline for me to keep track)

Anyway, thought you guys might like to know! :)

And, if anyone remembers "Kiara" - the woman from that training yard, that stepped up to fight colt in training - She gets a face reveal. Due to how well she was received, and liked, I've decided to transition her from a one-off side character, to a recurring one. You will see *much* more of Kiara in the coming updates ;)

notes.title: Official Steam Launch!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's been a long time coming (on my end, at least), but Rivers of Astrum: Daughter of Darkness is now officially live on Steam! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529429/7e87cbee5f985ac5402a1f0f1ab14860227b46fe.png[/img]

Follow [b]Kimberly Ashmoore[/b] ([u]and her pet squirrel, Dee![/u]) a young orphaned woman, as she journeys through the realm of Astrum, becoming embroiled in mysteries, plots and dangers that no one could have predicted! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529429/25e33e344501f118ab6f7a8fa165635e469280ac.png[/img]

The world of Astrum can be a beautiful and deadly place. The story can get fairly dark at many points. For that reason, the game contains nearly 40 in-game content filters for players to enable/disable content that doesn't suit their tastes. They can be accessed through the game's "Preferences" page. Please don't forget to use them! The story also has both heterosexual, and lesbian content, but since the story centers largely around a lesbian woman, the lesbian content cannot be toggled off. However, the hetero content can. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529429/eadd9bba857cd406c4276cb3d6a8c8d6a1668dd5.png[/img]

I want to take this time to thank everyone for their interest in Rivers of Astrum: Daughter of Darkness! Please feel free to visit the Discussion pages if you have any feedback, encounter any bugs, or just want to discuss the characters or the plot! I will make larger announcements here, but if you're the type that likes to get more real-time updates, then the game's [url=https://discord.gg/fTqXazge75]Discord Server[/url] is where you want to be!

Best Wishes!,

~Paper Tiger
